thesis: This episode argues that investors should identify massive 'winners-take-all' markets by looking for companies that dominate specific technology waves (like silicon, search, or social) and understand their unique distribution strategies. It also highlights the importance of evaluating business models based on lifetime value versus acquisition cost and suggests that certain organizational structures, like holocracies, may be flawed.
